case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Option A is our answer: a fair price for both family companies, with payment on a clear and reliable term.

We can approve Option A as the package, because the claims below show where the price stands today and what your quality has earned.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

On our past orders:
Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 125.45; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 126.17; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 126.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

Option A is the one we can stand behind.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. We would like to keep working with you as we have for many years.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. Our new Angebot is a price of €137.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: a price of €134.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You wrote that you value our cooperation and have made a step towards us. We appreciate that, and we are answering it with a serious step of our own, as one family company to another.

Our options below keep your shop working on a steady footing, with payment on a clear term that you can plan around. Option A is the package we can approve.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 126.80; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 127.52; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 128.25; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We have taken note of your point that your price reflects your costs. Option A is our answer to it, and we stand firmly behind it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In response to your step, we are making a further concession to €136.50 for your preferred Option A with 30 days payment and validity from 1 April 2027. 

For our family-run foundry, maintaining such long-standing traditions of cooperation with valued partners like Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH means everything to us. Our proposal comprises a price of €136.50 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This price is a fair reflection of our current operational realities while supporting your planning. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this updated Angebot demonstrates our commitment to our continued relationship, and we look forward to working together for many more years to come.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
